title: AI provisional checks (ai.json)
description: Provisional answers by an AI, shown as their own layer; a person adopts them or not. Every quote must occur in its file (build.py checks, ignoring whitespace, and computes the line). Something the target does not describe is tbd, never false.

target.description: What the claims were compared with, including its version (repository, branch, commit).

base.description: Folder that evidence file paths are relative to, relative to this source folder.

judgments.description: Node label -> judgment. Only leaves and nodes with own wording take a check.
